links.comparator_used: single fixed AI score threshold (≥35) applied across all lesion categories
links.outcome: diagnostic accuracy of AI mammographic lesion detection (ROC/Youden-derived thresholds) and radiologist-AI discordance
links.effect: Optimal threshold 19 for BI-RADS 4A (AUC = 0.685) and 63 for BI-RADS 4B/4C (AUC = 0.908). With the fixed cutoff of 35, discordant BI-RADS 4A lesions with scores ≥35 had a 43.8% malignancy rate, and BI-RADS 4B/4C lesions with scores <35 had a 19.5% malignancy rate.
links.tradeoff: BI-RADS 4A cases still show overlapping scores and limited discrimination (AUC 0.685), so radiologist oversight is still needed. The study was retrospective, with 194 mammograms.
links.quote: Using category-specific AI thresholds improves diagnostic accuracy and supports radiologist decision-making.
